incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sustained p95 latency > SLO for runtime-inference.hotpath (us-west-2)
incident-bot: Details: p95=420ms (SLO=200ms), p99=1.8s, window=7m. Trigger: latency-slo-heatmap > threshold. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/runtime/hotpath?region=us-west-2
incident-bot: Runbook: https://runbooks/internal/hotpath-latency. PagerDuty: page fired to @oncall-sara. Suggested next steps: check GPU util, autoscaler, kvcache evictions, route fallback.
oncall-sara: Ack @incident-bot, I'm on it. Checking the dashboard & logs now.
mike_infra: I see hotpath-usw2 GPU pool at ~96% utilization and request queue depth spiking. Several nodes reporting high GPU memory pressure.
oncall-sara: Copy. Kicking off manual scale of the pool. Running: ```rdwctl scale pool hotpath-usw2 --delta 2 --reason "p95 spike"```
deploy-bot: Scaling job started for pool hotpath-usw2 (+2 replicas). ETA ~90s.
lia_support: Field reports: some customers (org-345, alphafoo.com) reporting interactive playground lag ~2s. No API errors, just high latency. Liaison on it.
alex_sre: Seeing a KV cache eviction burst: `kvcache_usw2 evictions=120k last_10m` — likely cold-prefix churn after evictions. Also tokenization coldstarts are up on sidecars.
oncall-sara: Hmm, eviction storm could explain tail. Trying rapid warmup: `rdwctl warm cache --pool hotpath-usw2 --prefix-sample sled-1` (kicking off small warmup run).
mike_infra: Autoscaler metrics: scaling decision queued, but spot preemption/backfill delays causing slower spin-up. If scaling doesn't help fast, suggest routing small fraction to fallback variant (fast-quant-v2) to reduce tail.
oncall-sara: Enabling emergency route fallback for 10% traffic: ```routes set-weight /inference hotpath -> fast-quant-v2:10%```. Applied.
alex_sre: Routing change applied. Also toggled prewarm on two new replicas. Warmup logs: ```[warmup] model init ok; kvcache restore hit-rate=0.6 -> 0.84 after 90s```
oncall-sara: p95 is trending down to 260ms, p99 ~900ms. Better but still above SLO. Continuing monitoring.
jamie_prod: Noting customer impact for postmortem: interactive playground latency degraded for some orgs; no data loss. Drafting status blurb for ops channel.
lia_support: Adding affected orgs list to the ticket: org-345, org-778, org-912. Liaison sent temporary advisory to those accounts.
oncall-sara: Good. I'll keep the page open and do a handoff in 30m. If things remain stable for 30m, we'll close.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page acknowledged by oncall-sara. Auto-escalation suppressed.
mike_infra: GPU pool replicas are up, utilization dropping to 70-80%, queue length normalizing. No further preemptions observed.
oncall-sara: p95=210ms, p99=600ms now. Still slightly high at p99 but acceptable short-term. Will hand off to alex_sre for overnight watch.
alex_sre: Ack, I'll take over the watch and observe for 60m. I'll keep the fallback route in place until stable for 30m with no regression.
jamie_prod: Thx. I'll coordinate a short post-incident blurb after handoff with the timeline + mitigation steps.
oncall-sara: Handoff: oncall-sara -> alex_sre, notes: manual scale + fallback routing + kvcache warmup. Customer impact: transient increase in interactive latency, limited orgs, no errors.
alex_sre: Received. I'll monitor dashboards and close thread when stable for 30m.
incident-bot: Note: remember to run the post-incident checklist: https://checklists/internal/latency-p95-postmortem
oncall-sara: Adding a quick note to the ticket about potential root cause: kvcache eviction storm coupled with delayed replica spin-up due to spot/backfill. Recommend increasing prewarm buffer for hotpath pool and adjusting eviction threshold.
jamie_prod: Filing recommendation as follow-up action item: TECH-4521 (increase prewarm + tune eviction policy).
alex_sre: Closing update: p95=195ms, p99=210ms. Stable window reached. I'll close the PD page after 35m of continued stability.
